title: Jamaican Chicken Skewers
description: A flavorful and spicy twist on traditional French cuisine, featuring marinated chicken skewers with a hint of Jamaican jerk seasoning.

ingredients.name: Skewers
ingredients.notes: soaked in water for at least 30 minutes

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together jerk seasoning and olive oil.
Thread chicken and mildly spicy peppers onto skewers.
Brush skewers with jerk seasoning mixture and season with salt and pepper.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until chicken is cooked through.
Transfer skewers to a plate and squeeze lime juice over the top.
Sprinkle garlic and parsley over skewers and serve immediately.
